title: About The Eye Informatique
subtitle: Bringing quality technology to Cameroon since day one.

children.text: At The Eye Informatique, our mission is to make quality technology accessible and affordable for everyone in Cameroon. We believe that reliable tech shouldn't be a luxury — it should be within everyone's reach.

The Eye Informatique was founded with a simple idea: provide Cameroonians with access to quality technology products and professional repair services. Starting from a small shop in Bamenda, we've grown to serve customers across the country.
Today, with branches in multiple cities, we continue to expand our reach while maintaining the personal service and technical expertise that our customers trust.

faq.question: How do I join the affiliate program?

children.text: Simply click the 'Apply Now' button and fill out the registration form. Once submitted, your account will be activated and you can start sharing your referral link immediately.
Payouts are processed monthly. You'll receive your earnings via mobile money (MTN MoMo, Orange Money) or bank transfer, whichever you prefer.

faq.question: Is there a minimum payout threshold?

children.text: Yes, the minimum payout threshold is 5,000 XAF. Once your balance reaches this amount, it will be included in the next monthly payout cycle.
Absolutely! You can generate referral links for any product in our catalog. We also provide featured product lists and seasonal promotions to help you maximize your earnings.

children.text: 1. Acceptance of Terms
By accessing and using The Eye Informatique website and services, you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.
2. Products and Services

We sell new and refurbished electronic products including laptops, smartphones, tablets, and accessories. All refurbished products undergo thorough testing and come with a warranty. Product descriptions and images are as accurate as possible, but slight variations may occur.
3. Orders and Payment

All orders are subject to availability. Prices are listed in XAF (Central African CFA Franc) and include applicable taxes. Payment must be completed before orders are shipped. We accept mobile money payments and bank transfers.
4. Returns and Warranty

Products may be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are defective or do not match the description. Refurbished products come with a minimum 3-month warranty. New products carry the manufacturer's warranty. Please visit our Guarantee page for full details.
5. Contact
For any questions regarding these Terms of Service, please contact us at contact@theeyeinformatique.com.
